execution: Offline local CPU. Existing cached model and installed libraries; no uploads, credentials, paid API or new model download.
chunking: 200 whitespace words, stride 160; model token truncation applies
queries: initial grant agreement execution effective date signed HUD grant
allocation amendments budget increased reduced original award grant amount
cumulative expenditures obligations to date activity budget program income
economic development recovery creates retains jobs activity category
activities omitted quarterly report no change expenditures drawdowns difference
local city beneficiary activity location multi jurisdiction service area
retrieval: Normalized sentence embeddings, cosine similarity, top 12 per query
limits: Search only retrieved public municipal QPRs and five guides/audits. Cannot discover unlinked or unretrieved sites; not exhaustive. Ranking is a lead, never validation. Original page and deterministic grant/period/value checks required. No model-extracted fact automatically enters published financial data.
